title.original: TraCT: Disaggregated LLM Serving with CXL Shared Memory KV Cache at Rack-Scale
title.zh: TraCT：利用 CXL 共享内存 KV 缓存实现机架级解耦式 LLM 服务
title.en: TraCT: Disaggregated LLM Serving with CXL Shared Memory KV Cache at Rack-Scale

inclusion_reason.zh: TraCT 把 CXL 共享内存、同步协议和 KV 生命周期管理组合为机架级解耦推理数据平面。
inclusion_reason.en: TraCT combines CXL shared memory, synchronization, and KV lifecycle management into a reusable rack-scale data plane for disaggregated serving.

abstract.zh: TraCT 用机架级 CXL 共享内存替代 RDMA 网络路径，在解耦式 LLM 服务中同时承载预填充到解码的 KV 传输和共享前缀缓存。GPU 通过 load/store 与 DMA 直接访问 KV 块，减少 NIC 跳转和网络争用。
abstract.en: TraCT uses rack-scale CXL shared memory as both the prefill-to-decode KV-transfer path and a shared prefix cache for disaggregated LLM serving. GPUs access KV blocks through load/store and DMA, removing the NIC hop and reducing network contention.

problem.zh: 预填充与解码分离后必须搬运大体积 KV 张量；随模型与上下文增长，RDMA 路径主导 TTFT 和吞吐，并对网络拥塞高度敏感。
problem.en: Disaggregated serving must move large KV tensors from prefill to decode workers; with larger models and contexts, RDMA transfer dominates TTFT and throughput and becomes contention-sensitive.

approach.zh: TraCT 把 KV 块写入非一致性 CXL 共享内存，并设计两级跨节点同步、数据一致性和块管理机制，使预填充与解码 GPU 可直接交换状态。
approach.en: TraCT places KV blocks in non-coherent CXL memory and adds two-tier inter-node synchronization, consistency, and block-management mechanisms for direct GPU exchange.

system_design.zh: 在 Dynamo 服务框架中，CXL 内存池既接收预填充 GPU 写入，又向解码 GPU 暴露共享前缀；软件层维护块生命周期与跨节点可见性，而不依赖 NIC 中转。
system_design.en: Integrated with Dynamo, a CXL pool accepts writes from prefill GPUs and exposes shared prefixes to decode GPUs. Software tracks block lifetime and cross-node visibility without routing data through a NIC.

key_results.zh: 静态与合成工作负载中，TraCT 相比 RDMA 和 DRAM 缓存基线被报告可降低平均与尾部 TTFT，并提高峰值吞吐。
key_results.en: On static and synthetic workloads, TraCT is reported to lower average and tail TTFT and increase peak throughput over RDMA- and DRAM-cache baselines.

limitations.zh: 设计依赖机架内 CXL 共享内存与直接 GPU 访问；跨机架扩展、CXL 故障隔离、容量争用和非一致内存恢复未在摘要中评估。
limitations.en: The design requires rack-local CXL shared memory and direct GPU access; cross-rack scaling, failure isolation, capacity contention, and recovery of non-coherent state are not evaluated in the abstract.

notes.zh: 工作负载类别、机架级硬件、两类基线和三个上限来自官方摘要；模型、节点数和逐表配置待全文审计。
notes.en: Workload classes, rack-scale hardware, two baseline types, and three upper bounds come from the official abstract; models, node counts, and table-level settings await full-text audit.
